वेण्,
वेन् 1 U. (वेणति-ते, वेनति-ते) 
__1 To go, move. 
__2 To know, recognize, perceive. 
__3 To reflect, consider. 
__4 To take. 
__5 To play on an instrument. 
__6 To see. 
__7 To praise, worship.
__1 A musician by caste; cf. वैदेहकेन त्वम्बुष्ठपामुत्पन्नो बेण उच्यते [[

]]; वेणानां भाण्डवादनम् 10. 49. 
__2 N. of a king, son of Aṅga and said to be a descendant of Manu Svāyambhuva. [When he became king, he issued a proclamation prohibiting all worship and sacrifices. The sages strongly remonstrated with him, but when he turned a deaf ear to their words, they killed him with ‘blades of consecrated Kuśa grass.’ The kingdom was now without a ruler. So they rubbed the thigh of the dead body, until a Niṣāda came forth, short in stature and with a flat face. They then rubbed the right arm, and from it sprang the majestic Pṛthu (see Pṛthu). According to the Padma Purāṇa, Veṇa began his reign well, but subsequently fell in to Jaina heresy. He is also said to have caused confusion of castes; cf. [[

]]; 9. 66-67.]. 
__3 A worker in reed or bamboo; [[
N. of a river (joining the Kṛṣṇā).

]]] 
__1 Braided hair, a braid of hair; तरङ्गिणी बेणिरिवायता भुवः [[Śi. 12. 75]]; [[

.]] 
__2 Hair twisted into a single unornamented braid and allowed to fall on the back (said to be worn by women whose husbands are absent from them); वनान्निवृत्तेन रघूत्तमेन मुक्ता स्वयं बेणिरिबाबभासे [[

.]] 
__3 Continuous flow, current, stream; जलवेणिरम्यां रेवां यदि प्रेक्षितुमस्ति कामः [[

]]; प्रवृत्तबाष्पवेणिकं चक्षुः प्रमृज्य [[K.]]; cf. the word त्रिवेणि also. 
__4 The confluence of two or more rivers. 
__5 The confluence of the Ganges, Yamunā and Sarasvatī. 
__6 N. of a river. 
__7 The property re-united after it has been before divided. 
__8 A cascade. 
__9 A dam, bridge. 
__10 A ewe. 
-Comp. 
-बन्धः hair twisted into a braid; मोक्ष्यध्वे स्वर्गबन्दीनां बेणीबन्धानदूषितान् [[

.]] 
-वेधनी a leech. 
-वेधिनी a comb. 
-संहारः 
__1 tying the hair into a braid; [[

.]] 
__2 N. of a drama by Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa.

__1 Braided hair. 
__2 A continuous line, uninterrupted stream.

]]] 
__1 A bamboo; मलयेऽपि स्थितो बेणुर्बेणुरेव न चन्दनम् [[Subhāṣ.]]; [[

.]] 
__2 A reed, cane; प्राप्तापराधास्ताडपाः स्यू रज्ज्बा बेणुदलेन बा [[

.]] 
__3 A flute, pipe; वेणुं क्वणन्तीं क्रीडन्तीम् [[

]]; cf. त्रिवेणु. 
-Comp. [Page1495-2] 
-कर्करः the Karavīra plant. 
-जः bamboo-seed. 
-दलम् a split bamboo; [[
]]; cf. बेणुवैदल made of split bamboo; [[

.]] 
-निस्रुतिः the sugar-cane. 
-बीजम् bamboo-seed. 
-यवः bamboo-seed. 
-यष्टिः f. a bamboo-stick. 
-वादः, -वादकः a piper, flute-player.

A goad with a bamboo-handle. 
-कः 
__1 A flute. 
__2 A flute-player; नर्तक्यो वारमुख्याश्च गायका वेणुकास्तथा [[A.
